root_cause: a + b overflows for large operands of the same sign (CBMC: arithmetic overflow on signed + in a + b, src/midpoint.c:5; UBSan: signed integer overflow 2147483647 + 2147483647 in test 'extremes').
rationale: Divide each operand by two before adding: |a/2 + b/2| <= INT_MAX, so the addition can no longer overflow.
